name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: A broken barrel on Westfall's western shore holds Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure clue. It sends you north toward an old jug beside a coastal windmill, another step along the late pirate's trail to his hidden riches.

sections.title: A Pirate's Breadcrumb Trail
sections.body: Captain Sanders scattered his directions along Westfall's western shore. Each clue leads only to the next container, never straight to the prize. You have to follow the trail from one barrel, chest, or jug to another across the bluffs to reach his plunder.

sections.title: North Toward the Bluffs
sections.body: From the broken barrel, the parchment points due north toward the sea cliffs. Beside an isolated windmill on the bluffs, an abandoned jug holds the next clue. Murlocs and Defias scavengers roam coastal Westfall, so the way north carries danger.

faq.q: What is Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure?
faq.answer: Captain Sanders was a buccaneer who hid his riches along the Westfall coast. He left written riddles in barrels, chests, and jugs across the countryside instead of a map.

faq.q: Where does this third clue lead?
faq.answer: The parchment points due north from the broken barrel to the ocean bluffs. Near a lone windmill, an old jug holds the next clue.

faq.q: Why did Sanders hide his directions in pieces?
faq.answer: Sanders split his directions to protect his treasure from mutinous crewmates and rival marauders. Finding one clue alone would not reveal the whole route.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this trail?
faq.answer: Yes. Any adventurer can interact with the clues and objects tied to Captain Sanders' cache, though Westfall lies deep in Alliance territory.

faq.q: Does this clue directly reveal the chest?
aliases: is the treasure in the jug
faq.answer: No. The jug near the coastal windmill holds another clue pointing to Sanders' chest, making this the penultimate step in the hunt.

faq.q: What dangers surround the trail to the windmill?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls, coastal murlocs, and roving Defias bandits prowl Westfall's western bluffs and beaches. A straight march north can be treacherous.

angles.text: As a rogue, following a scoundrel's trail of concealed messages and hidden markers along the bluffs may feel familiar.
With Westfall gripped by famine and Defias outlaws, Sanders' lost pirate plunder offers you a welcome windfall.
